why: Mana pass on responses-v3 (2026-09-11): blue is 16 short and black 11 short of Karsten targets driven by two double-pip cards (Marang River Regent UU, Crux of Fate BB), with two logged losses to colours. Six mono- or two-colour lands out for six fetchlands: with seven shocks and three battle lands in the list every fetch is an untapped five-colour source, so blue and black rise without red falling. Three basic Mountains stay for Canopy Vista / Cinder Glade / Smoldering Marsh and Blood Moon. The goldfish cannot rank two lands that make the same colours; mana-analysis on-curve rates are the evidence, and this objective (two dead turns in a row, 0.078 today) is the one goldfish row a colour screw shows in.
